Intro: Hey, chef, I've been out there thinking about how I could try to make some real change, and I have an idea. It's going to involve you, though.
Remember that old man who visits your store? One of my buddies said she remembered seeing his face before in some pamphlet.
We did some digging, and found out that he used to do work for Svetka. Normally, I would just go ahead and mess with him…but he seems pitiful.
Could you double check for us he ain't some super fucked up dude. Show this pamphlet to him, maybe it will give us a clue? Community is counting on you!
Success: Thanks, Chef! I'll be nearby if anything goes wrong.
Fail: Off today, Chef? What's wrong, getting cold feet?
Reject: What, you too scared to rebel? Didn't realize you were a goddamn coward, Chef.
